import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, k;
    static long mod;
    static int[] fact = new int[262155];
    static int[] invFact = new int[262155];
    static int[] logArr = new int[262155];
    static int[] cnt2 = new int[262155];
    static int[][] dp = new int[262155][31];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[262155][31];
    static List<Pair> record = new ArrayList<>();
    static Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int f, int s) {
            this.first = f;
            this.second = s;
        }
    }

    static int readInt(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        int x = 0;
        boolean neg = false;
        int c;
        while (true) {
            c = br.read();
            if (c == -1) break;
            if (c == '-') {
                neg = true;
                break;
            }
            if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                x = c - '0';
                break;
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            c = br.read();
            if (c == -1 || !Character.isDigit(c)) break;
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
        return neg ? -x : x;
    }

    static long readLong(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        long x = 0;
        boolean neg = false;
        int c;
        while (true) {
            c = br.read();
            if (c == -1) break;
            if (c == '-') {
                neg = true;
                break;
            }
            if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                x = c - '0';
                break;
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            c = br.read();
            if (c == -1 || !Character.isDigit(c)) break;
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
        return neg ? -x : x;
    }

    static int countDiv2(int x) {
        int c = 0;
        while (x != 0 && (x & 1) == 0) {
            c++;
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return c;
    }

    static int power(int base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        long b = base;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) res;
    }

    static int choose(int n, int m) {
        return (int) (((long) fact[n] * invFact[m] % mod) * invFact[n - m] % mod);
    }

    static int solve(int n, int k) {
        if (n == 0) return 1;
        if (k == 0) return 0;
        if (dp[n][k] != -1) return dp[n][k];
        int res = 0;
        int limit = 1 << logArr[n];
        for (int i = n; i >= limit; i -= 2) {
            res = (res + (long) choose(n, i) * solve(n - i, k - 1) % mod * k) % mod;
        }
        return dp[n][k] = res;
    }

    static int performBFS(int n, int k) {
        q.clear();
        record.clear();
        q.add(new Pair(n, k));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair p = q.poll();
            int x = p.first;
            int y = p.second;
            record.add(new Pair(x, y));
            if (x == 0 || y == 0) continue;
            int limit = 1 << logArr[x];
            for (int i = x; i >= limit; i -= 2) {
                if (cnt2[i] + cnt2[x - i] == cnt2[x] && !visited[i][y - 1]) {
                    visited[i][y - 1] = true;
                    q.add(new Pair(i, y - 1));
                }
            }
        }
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = record.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            Pair p = record.get(i);
            int x = p.first;
            int y = p.second;
            if (x == 0) {
                res = 1;
                continue;
            }
            if (y == 0) {
                res = 0;
                continue;
            }
            int limit = 1 << logArr[x];
            for (int i = x; i >= limit; i -= 2) {
                if (cnt2[i] + cnt2[x - i] == cnt2[x]) {
                    res = (int) ((res + (long) choose(x, i) * dp[x - i][y - 1] % mod * y) % mod);
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = readInt(br);
        k = readInt(br);
        mod = readLong(br);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 262150; i++) {
            fact[i] = (int) ((i == 0) ? 1 : ((long) fact[i - 1] * i) % mod);
            logArr[i] = (i > 0) ? logArr[i >> 1] + 1 : -1;
            cnt2[i] = cnt2[i - 1] + countDiv2(i);
        }
        Arrays.fill(dp, -1);
        invFact[262150] = power(fact[262150], mod - 2);
        for (int i = 262149; i > 0; i--) {
            invFact[i] = (int) ((long) invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod);
        }
        invFact[0] = invFact[1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 262150; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 31; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        if ((n & 1) != 0) {
            System.out.println(power(k, n));
        } else {
            int cnt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 62; i++) {
                if ((n & (1L << i)) != 0) cnt++;
            }
            int ans = power(k, n);
            int bfsRes = performBFS(n, k);
            int result = (ans - bfsRes) % (int) mod;
            if (result < 0) result += (int) mod;
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }
}
